mobile-optimized.usage: These presets use CPU-efficient settings while maintaining sound quality for mobile devices
optimizationNotes: Keep unisono voices at 4 or less for mobile CPU efficiency
Use simpler waveforms (sine, triangle) where possible
Presets are .gms format compatible with both Desktop and Mobile

mobilePresets.name: Mobile 808
mobilePresets.description: Efficient sub bass for mobile production

mobileWorkflowTips: Save presets in .gms format for cross-platform compatibility
Test patches on both desktop and mobile before finalizing
Use freeze/render for complex patches in mobile projects
Keep polyphony in mind - mobile has limited voices
Export audio from mobile for desktop refinement
Use simpler waveforms on mobile for CPU headroom
Limit simultaneous GMS instances on mobile devices

genre-conventions.usage: Follow these rules when designing sounds for specific musical genres

leads.fx: FLNG + RVRB + optional DIST for saturation
leads.envelope: Fast attack, medium decay, high sustain

bass.filter: LP with modulation, try BP for midrange
bass.fx: DIST essential, HPF to clean mud

crossGenrePrinciples.rule: Keep sub frequencies in mono (0% stereo spread)
3-6kHz range must be audible for intelligibility
Use reverb and wide stereo for atmospheric elements

sound-design-rules.description: Sound design decision rules - symptom to solution mappings for GMS synthesis
sound-design-rules.usage: Use these rules to diagnose and fix common synthesis problems

rules.symptom: Sound is thin, weak, lacks body
Bass sounds weak, no punch or sub presence
Lead doesn't cut through the mix
Sound is too sterile, digital, lacks character
FM mode sounds too harsh or chaotic
Pad sounds lifeless, boring, no movement
Pluck sound has too much sustain, not percussive
Sound loses power in mono, phase cancellation
Wobble bass not rhythmic or irregular
FX are overwhelming the sound, too much effect
GMS causing CPU spikes or audio dropouts
